`RootDesk/MyDesk/components/Stage2_ServerState.mlua`
```lua
@Component
script Stage2_ServerState extends Component

    property integer _tickSeq = 0
    property integer _timerId = 0
    property number _timeAlive = 0
    property string _enemyTemplateName = "EnemyBasic"
    property string _enemyTemplateModelId = "model://enemybasic"
    property number _spawnInterval = 2.0
    property number _spawnMinR = 1300
    property number _spawnMaxR = 1600
    property string _enemyDebugSpriteRuid = "b871399ae18d41c4b76c2ae79feefa7d"
    property integer _enemyCount = 0
    property integer _spawnTimerId = 0
    property number _hitRadius = 120
    property number _hitCooldown = 0.5
    property table _enemyLastHitAt = {}
    property table _pendingCombatEvents = {}
    property table _subscribers = {}
    property table _lifeCmds = {}
    property boolean _lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
    property table _activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
    property table _stageHandlers = {}
    property integer _runSeed = 0
    property boolean _debugLogs = true
    property boolean _selfTestCombat = false
    property boolean _selfTestCombatDone = false

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void OnBeginPlay()
        self._tickSeq = 0
        self._timerId = 0
        self._timeAlive = 0
        self._enemyCount = 0
        self._spawnTimerId = 0
        self._enemyLastHitAt = {}
        self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        self._subscribers = {}
        self._lifeCmds = {}
        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
        self._stageHandlers = {}
        self._selfTestCombatDone = false
        if self._runSeed == 0 then
            local seed = math.floor((os.clock() * 1000000) + (_UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds * 1000))
            seed = seed % 2147483647
            if seed <= 0 then
                seed = 1
            end
            self._runSeed = seed
        end
        self:_InitStageHandlers()

        self:Start10Hz()
        self:StartSpawner()

        log("[S2] ServerState start (10Hz + spawner)")
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void OnEndPlay()
        if self._timerId > 0 then
            _TimerService:ClearTimer(self._timerId)
            self._timerId = 0
        end
        if self._spawnTimerId > 0 then
            _TimerService:ClearTimer(self._spawnTimerId)
            self._spawnTimerId = 0
        end

        self._subscribers = {}
        self._enemyLastHitAt = {}
        self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        self._lifeCmds = {}
        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
        self._stageHandlers = {}
        self._selfTestCombatDone = false
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void Start10Hz()
        if self._timerId > 0 then
            return
        end

        local repeatFunc = function()
            self:Tick10Hz()
        end

        -- interval=0.1, isRepeat=true, startDelay=0.1
        self._timerId = _TimerService:SetTimer(self, repeatFunc, 0.1, true, 0.1)
        if self._timerId == 0 then
            log_error("[S2] failed to reserve 10Hz timer")
        elseif self._debugLogs then
            log("[S2] 10Hz timer reserved id=" .. tostring(self._timerId))
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void Tick10Hz()
        local frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
        self:RunFrameLoop(frame)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table CreateFrameContext()
        local nextSeq = self._tickSeq + 1
        local dt = 0.1
        local nextTimeAlive = self._timeAlive + dt
        local now = _UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds
        local frameEvents = {}
        local frameLifeCmds = {}
        local mod = 4294967296
        local seedBase = tonumber(self._runSeed) or 1
        local rngState = (seedBase * 1664525 + nextSeq * 69069 + 1013904223) % mod
        if rngState <= 0 then
            rngState = 1
        end

        return {
            seq = nextSeq,
            dt = dt,
            now = now,
            runSeed = self._runSeed,
            rngState = rngState,
            timeAlive = nextTimeAlive,
            world = self,
            input = self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(nextSeq),
            payload = {
                seq = nextSeq,
                serverTime = now,
                timeAlive = nextTimeAlive,
                enemyCount = self._enemyCount
            },
            events = frameEvents,
            outbox = frameEvents,
            lifeCmds = frameLifeCmds
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table GetFrameStageOrder()
        return {
            "Input",
            "Update",
            "CollisionResolve",
            "Render"
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _InitStageHandlers()
        self._stageHandlers = {
            Input = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Input(frame)
            end,
            Update = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Update(frame)
            end,
            CollisionResolve = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_CollisionResolve(frame)
            end,
            Render = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Render(frame)
            end
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void RunFrameLoop(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end

        local stageOrder = self:GetFrameStageOrder()
        for _, stageName in ipairs(stageOrder) do
            self:RunFrameStage(stageName, frame)
            if stageName == "Update" then
                self:ApplyLifeCmds(frame)
            elseif stageName == "CollisionResolve" then
                self:_PromoteFrameCombatEventsToPending(frame)
            end
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void RunFrameStage(string stageName, table frame)
        if self._stageHandlers == nil or self._stageHandlers[stageName] == nil then
            self:_InitStageHandlers()
        end

        local handler = self._stageHandlers[stageName]
        if handler ~= nil then
            handler(frame)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Input(table frame)
        frame.input = self:sampleInput(frame)
        if frame.input == nil then
            frame.input = self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(frame.seq)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Update(table frame)
        self:_RunCombatSelfTest(frame)
        self:_ProcessPendingCombatEvents()

        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = true
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = frame.lifeCmds
        self:_FlushPendingLifeCmdsToFrame(frame)

        log("[ServerState] Tick10Hz seq=" .. tostring(frame.seq))
        self._tickSeq = frame.seq
        self._timeAlive = frame.timeAlive

        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_CollisionResolve(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end

        local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or ownerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.TransformComponent == nil then
            return
        end
        local playerPos = ownerEntity.TransformComponent.Position
        if playerPos == nil then
            return
        end

        local ownerState = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ownerState ~= nil and ownerState.isDead then
            return
        end

        local mapEntity = self:_ResolveSpawnParent(ownerEntity)
        if mapEntity == nil then
            return
        end

        local enemyAiComponents = mapEntity:GetChildComponentsByTypeName("EnemyAI", true)
        if enemyAiComponents == nil then
            return
        end

        local hitRadius = tonumber(self._hitRadius) or 120
        local hitCooldown = tonumber(self._hitCooldown) or 0.5
        local hitRadiusSq = hitRadius * hitRadius
        local now = tonumber(frame.now) or _UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds

        for _, enemyAi in pairs(enemyAiComponents) do
            if enemyAi ~= nil then
                local enemyEntity = enemyAi.Entity
                if enemyEntity ~= nil and enemyEntity.TransformComponent ~= nil then
                    local enemyPos = enemyEntity.TransformComponent.Position
                    if enemyPos ~= nil then
                        local dx = playerPos.x - enemyPos.x
                        local dy = playerPos.y - enemyPos.y
                        local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
                        if distSq <= hitRadiusSq then
                            local enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity.ID)
                            if enemyKey == "" or enemyKey == "nil" then
                                enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity.Name)
                            end
                            if enemyKey == "" or enemyKey == "nil" then
                                enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity)
                            end

                            local lastHitAt = tonumber(self._enemyLastHitAt[enemyKey]) or -999999
                            if (now - lastHitAt) >= hitCooldown then
                                self._enemyLastHitAt[enemyKey] = now
                                self:QueueCombatEvent(frame, userId, {
                                    k = "hit",
                                    src = "enemy",
                                    enemy = enemyKey,
                                    t = now
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Render(table frame)
        local subCount = self:_GetSubscriberCount()
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[S2][ServerTick] seq=" .. tostring(frame.seq) .. " subs=" .. tostring(subCount))
        end

        for userId, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            self:CallClientHUD_OnServerTick(userId, frame.payload)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table sampleInput(table frame)
        -- Task 5: InputFrame SSOT. External input ingestion is intentionally deferred.
        if frame == nil then
            return self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(0)
        end
        return self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(frame.seq)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void QueueCombatEvent(table frame, string userId, table payload)
        if frame == nil or payload == nil or userId == nil then
            return
        end
        if frame.events == nil then
            frame.events = {}
        end
        table.insert(frame.events, {
            userId = tostring(userId),
            payload = payload
        })
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _PromoteFrameCombatEventsToPending(table frame)
        if frame == nil or frame.events == nil then
            return
        end
        if #frame.events <= 0 then
            return
        end
        if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
            self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        end
        for _, evt in ipairs(frame.events) do
            table.insert(self._pendingCombatEvents, evt)
        end
        self:_ClearArray(frame.events)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ProcessPendingCombatEvents()
        if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
            self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
            return
        end
        if #self._pendingCombatEvents <= 0 then
            return
        end

        for _, evt in ipairs(self._pendingCombatEvents) do
            if evt ~= nil then
                local userId = tostring(evt.userId or "")
                local payload = evt.payload
                if userId ~= "" and payload ~= nil then
                    self:_ApplyCombatEventToPlayer(userId, payload)
                    self:SendCombatEventToUser(userId, payload)
                end
            end
        end

        self:_ClearArray(self._pendingCombatEvents)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplyCombatEventToPlayer(string userId, table payload)
        if payload == nil or payload.k ~= "hit" then
            return
        end

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            return
        end
        local ps = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ps == nil then
            return
        end

        self:_EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(ps)
        if ps.isDead then
            return
        end

        local dmg = 1
        local hpNow = tonumber(ps.hp) or 0
        hpNow = hpNow - dmg
        if hpNow < 0 then
            hpNow = 0
        end
        ps.hp = hpNow
        ps.isDead = (hpNow <= 0)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(any ps)
        if ps == nil then
            return
        end

        local hpMax = tonumber(ps.hpMax)
        if hpMax == nil or hpMax <= 0 then
            hpMax = 10
            ps.hpMax = hpMax
        end

        local hp = tonumber(ps.hp)
        if hp == nil then
            hp = hpMax
            ps.hp = hp
        end

        if ps.isDead == nil then
            ps.isDead = false
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _RunCombatSelfTest(table frame)
        if self._selfTestCombat ~= true then
            return
        end
        if self._selfTestCombatDone == true then
            return
        end
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end

        local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            log_error("[S2][SelfTest] combat fail owner=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            self._selfTestCombatDone = true
            self._selfTestCombat = false
            return
        end

        local ps = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ps == nil then
            log_error("[S2][SelfTest] combat fail PlayerState=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            self._selfTestCombatDone = true
            self._selfTestCombat = false
            return
        end

        self:_EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(ps)
        local hpMax = tonumber(ps.hpMax) or 10
        local beforeHp = tonumber(ps.hp) or hpMax
        if beforeHp <= 0 then
            beforeHp = hpMax
            ps.hp = beforeHp
            ps.isDead = false
        end

        if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
            self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        end
        table.insert(self._pendingCombatEvents, {
            userId = userId,
            payload = {
                k = "hit",
                src = "enemy",
                enemy = "selftest",
                t = frame.now
            }
        })

        self:_ProcessPendingCombatEvents()

        local afterHp = tonumber(ps.hp) or -999999
        local expectedHp = beforeHp - 1
        if expectedHp < 0 then
            expectedHp = 0
        end

        if afterHp == expectedHp then
            log("[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_ok hp=" .. tostring(afterHp))
        else
            log_error("[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_fail before=" .. tostring(beforeHp) .. " after=" .. tostring(afterHp) .. " expected=" .. tostring(expectedHp))
        end

        self._selfTestCombatDone = true
        self._selfTestCombat = false
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table _MakeDefaultInputFrame(number seq)
        local normalizedSeq = math.floor(tonumber(seq) or 0)
        if normalizedSeq < 0 then
            normalizedSeq = 0
        end
        return {
            v = 1,
            seq = normalizedSeq,
            moveX = 0,
            moveY = 0,
            aimX = 0,
            aimY = 0,
            fire = false,
            dash = false,
            pause = false
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void EnqueueSpawn(table cmd)
        self:_EnqueueLifeCmd("spawn", cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void EnqueueDespawn(table cmd)
        self:_EnqueueLifeCmd("despawn", cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _EnqueueLifeCmd(string kind, table cmd)
        if cmd == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmds == nil then
            self._lifeCmds = {}
        end

        if kind == "spawn" then
            table.insert(self._lifeCmds, {
                k = "spawn",
                modelId = cmd.modelId,
                name = cmd.name,
                pos = cmd.pos,
                parent = cmd.parent,
                extra = cmd.extra
            })
            return
        end
        if kind == "despawn" then
            table.insert(self._lifeCmds, {
                k = "despawn",
                entity = cmd.entity,
                path = cmd.path
            })
            return
        end

        log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue unknown kind=" .. tostring(kind))
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ClearArray(table arr)
        if arr == nil then
            return
        end
        for i = #arr, 1, -1 do
            arr[i] = nil
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _FlushPendingLifeCmdsToFrame(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmds == nil then
            self._lifeCmds = {}
            return
        end
        if #self._lifeCmds <= 0 then
            return
        end

        for _, cmd in ipairs(self._lifeCmds) do
            self:_PushLifeCmd(cmd)
        end
        self:_ClearArray(self._lifeCmds)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _PushLifeCmd(table cmd)
        if cmd == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmdWriteOpen == false then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue blocked (Update stage only) k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            return
        end
        if self._activeFrameLifeCmds == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue blocked (active frame queue is nil) k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            return
        end
        table.insert(self._activeFrameLifeCmds, cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void ApplyLifeCmds(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end
        if frame.lifeCmds == nil then
            return
        end

        for index, cmd in ipairs(frame.lifeCmds) do
            if cmd == nil or cmd.k == nil then
                log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] invalid command at index=" .. tostring(index))
            elseif cmd.k == "spawn" then
                self:_ApplySpawnCmd(cmd)
            elseif cmd.k == "despawn" then
                -- Task 3-b: despawn path is reserved and intentionally no-op in this commit.
            else
                log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] unknown command k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            end
        end

        self:_ClearArray(frame.lifeCmds)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplySpawnCmd(table cmd)
        local modelId = cmd.modelId
        local spawnName = cmd.name
        local spawnPos = cmd.pos
        local spawnParent = cmd.parent
        if modelId == nil or modelId == "" then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing modelId")
            return
        end
        if spawnPos == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing pos")
            return
        end
        if spawnParent == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing parent")
            return
        end

        local spawned = _SpawnService:SpawnByModelId(modelId, spawnName, spawnPos, spawnParent)
        if spawned == nil then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed EnemyBasic spawn template/model ref id=" .. tostring(modelId))
            return
        end

        if spawned.TransformComponent == nil then
            spawned:AddComponent("MOD.Core.TransformComponent")
        end
        if spawned.TransformComponent ~= nil then
            spawned.TransformComponent.Position = spawnPos
        end

        local extra = cmd.extra
        if extra == nil then
            extra = {}
        end

        if extra.applyDebugVisual ~= false then
            self:_ApplyEnemyDebugVisual(spawned)
        end

        local aiType = extra.aiType
        if aiType == nil or aiType == "" then
            aiType = "Chase"
        end
        local moveSpeed = tonumber(extra.moveSpeed) or 0
        local targetUserId = tostring(extra.targetUserId or "")
        local enemyAi = spawned.EnemyAI
        if enemyAi == nil then
            log_error("[S2][EnemyAI] missing on spawned enemy name=" .. tostring(spawned.Name))
        else
            enemyAi._serverState = self
            enemyAi.aiType = aiType
            enemyAi.moveSpeed = moveSpeed
            if targetUserId ~= "" then
                enemyAi:StartAI(targetUserId)
            else
                log_error("[S2][EnemyAI] missing targetUserId for spawned enemy name=" .. tostring(spawned.Name))
            end
            log("[S2][EnemyAI] set type=" .. tostring(aiType) .. " speed=" .. tostring(moveSpeed) .. " target=" .. tostring(targetUserId))
        end
        log(string.format("[S2][Spawn] type=%s speed=%.1f", aiType, moveSpeed))

        self._enemyCount = self._enemyCount + 1
        local spawnR = tonumber(extra.spawnR) or 0
        log(string.format("[S2][Spawn] spawned EnemyBasic count=%d pos=(%.1f, %.1f) r=%.1f", self._enemyCount, spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnR))
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void CallClientHUD_OnServerTick(string userId, table payload)
        userId = tostring(userId)

        local playerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if playerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend playerEntity=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        if playerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or playerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend ownerMismatch userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local clientHud = playerEntity.Stage2_ClientHUD
        if clientHud == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend Stage2_ClientHUD=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        if clientHud.EnableInHierarchy == false then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend Stage2_ClientHUD disabled userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local ps = playerEntity.PlayerState
        if ps == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend PlayerState=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        -- targetUserId must be the last argument.
        log("[ServerState] SendTo " .. tostring(userId))
        local outPayload = {
            seq = payload.seq,
            serverTime = payload.serverTime,
            timeAlive = payload.timeAlive,
            enemyCount = payload.enemyCount,
            hp = ps.hp,
            hpMax = ps.hpMax,
            isDead = ps.isDead
        }
        clientHud:OnServerTick10Hz(outPayload, userId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SendCombatEventToUser(string userId, table payload)
        if payload == nil then
            return
        end

        userId = tostring(userId)
        local playerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if playerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip playerEntity=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end
        if playerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or playerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip ownerMismatch userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local clientHud = playerEntity.Stage2_ClientHUD
        if clientHud == nil or clientHud.EnableInHierarchy == false then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip hud_unavailable userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        clientHud:OnCombatEvent(payload, userId)
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState][Combat] send k=" .. tostring(payload.k) .. " userId=" .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void StartSpawner()
        if self._spawnTimerId > 0 then
            return
        end
        if self._spawnInterval <= 0 then
            self._spawnInterval = 2.0
        end

        local repeatFunc = function()
            local frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
            self:SpawnEnemy(frame)
        end

        self._spawnTimerId = _TimerService:SetTimer(self, repeatFunc, self._spawnInterval, true, self._spawnInterval)
        if self._spawnTimerId == 0 then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed to reserve timer")
        else
            log("[S2][Spawn] timer reserved id=" .. tostring(self._spawnTimerId))
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SpawnEnemy(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
        end

        local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        if userId == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip no subscriber")
            end
            return
        end

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(tostring(userId))
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip playerEntity=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.TransformComponent == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip player TransformComponent=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end

        local ownerState = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ownerState ~= nil and ownerState.isDead then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip owner dead userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end

        local basePos = ownerEntity.TransformComponent.Position
        if basePos == nil then
            basePos = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
        end

        local spawnPos = self:_BuildSpawnPosition(frame, basePos)
        local dx = spawnPos.x - basePos.x
        local dy = spawnPos.y - basePos.y
        local spawnR = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local spawnParent = self:_ResolveSpawnParent(ownerEntity)
        if spawnParent == nil then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed parent nil")
            return
        end

        local spawnName = self._enemyTemplateName .. "_" .. tostring(self._enemyCount + 1)
        local modelId = self._enemyTemplateModelId
        if modelId == nil or modelId == "" then
            modelId = "model://" .. string.lower(self._enemyTemplateName)
        end
        local aiType = self:_PickEnemyAiType(frame)
        local nextState, moveSpeed = self:_RngRange(frame.rngState, 200, 320)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        self:EnqueueSpawn({
            modelId = modelId,
            name = spawnName,
            pos = spawnPos,
            parent = spawnParent,
            extra = {
                targetUserId = tostring(userId),
                basePos = basePos,
                spawnR = spawnR,
                aiType = aiType,
                moveSpeed = moveSpeed,
                applyDebugVisual = true
            }
        })
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        for userId, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            return userId
        end
        return nil
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Entity _ResolveSpawnParent(Entity ownerEntity)
        if ownerEntity ~= nil and ownerEntity.CurrentMap ~= nil then
            return ownerEntity.CurrentMap
        end
        if self.Entity ~= nil and self.Entity.CurrentMap ~= nil then
            return self.Entity.CurrentMap
        end
        return _EntityService:GetEntityByPath("/maps/map01")
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Vector3 _BuildSpawnPosition(table frame, Vector3 basePos)
        local minR = self._spawnMinR
        local maxR = self._spawnMaxR
        if minR <= 0 then
            minR = 700
        end
        if maxR < minR then
            maxR = minR
        end

        local nextState, theta01 = self:_RngNext01(frame.rngState)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        local theta = theta01 * 2.0 * math.pi
        local nextState2, r = self:_RngRange(frame.rngState, minR, maxR)
        frame.rngState = nextState2
        local ox = math.cos(theta) * r
        local oy = math.sin(theta) * r
        return Vector3(basePos.x + ox, basePos.y + oy, basePos.z)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplyEnemyDebugVisual(Entity enemyEntity)
        if enemyEntity == nil then
            return
        end

        if enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent == nil then
            enemyEntity:AddComponent("MOD.Core.SpriteRendererComponent")
        end
        if enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent ~= nil then
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.SpriteRUID = self._enemyDebugSpriteRuid
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.SortingLayer = "Default"
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.OrderInLayer = 20
        end

        if enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent == nil then
            enemyEntity:AddComponent("MOD.Core.TextRendererComponent")
        end
        if enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent ~= nil then
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.Text = self._enemyTemplateName
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.FontSize = 14
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.FontColor = Color(1, 0.25, 0.25, 1)
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.SortingLayer = "Default"
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.OrderInLayer = 21
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.RectSize = Vector2(3, 1)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method string _PickEnemyAiType(table frame)
        -- 70% Chase, 30% Zigzag
        local nextState, roll = self:_RngNext01(frame.rngState)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        if roll < 0.3 then
            return "Zigzag"
        end
        return "Chase"
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngNextU32(number state)
        local mod = 4294967296
        local s = math.floor(tonumber(state) or 0)
        if s <= 0 then
            s = 1
        end
        local nextState = (1664525 * s + 1013904223) % mod
        if nextState <= 0 then
            nextState = 1
        end
        return nextState, nextState
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngNext01(number state)
        local nextState, value = self:_RngNextU32(state)
        return nextState, value / 4294967296
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngRange(number state, number minValue, number maxValue)
        local minV = tonumber(minValue) or 0
        local maxV = tonumber(maxValue) or 0
        if maxV < minV then
            local tmp = minV
            minV = maxV
            maxV = tmp
        end
        local nextState, t = self:_RngNext01(state)
        return nextState, minV + (maxV - minV) * t
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Entity FindPlayerEntityByUserId(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return _UserService:GetUserEntityByUserId(userId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SubscribeUser(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)
        self._subscribers[userId] = true
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[Server] Subscribe " .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void UnsubscribeUser(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)
        self._subscribers[userId] = nil
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[Server] Unsubscribe " .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method integer _GetSubscriberCount()
        local count = 0
        for _, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            count = count + 1
        end
        return count
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    @EventSender("Service", "UserService")
    handler HandleUserEnterEvent(UserEnterEvent event)
        if event == nil then
            return
        end

        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState] UserEnterEvent " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        end

        log("[ServerState] Subscribe " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        self:SubscribeUser(event.UserId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    @EventSender("Service", "UserService")
    handler HandleUserLeaveEvent(UserLeaveEvent event)
        if event == nil then
            return
        end

        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState] UserLeaveEvent " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        end

        self:UnsubscribeUser(event.UserId)
    end

end
```

`tools/ci/hitvfx_contract_test.py`
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic contract test for Stage2 HitVFX controller behavior."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass
class HitVfxControllerModel:
    duration: float = 0.30
    step: float = 0.02
    active: bool = False
    timer_id: int = 0
    timer_counter: int = 1
    token: int = 0
    seq: int = 0
    end_time: float = -1e9
    peak_alpha: float = 0.0
    alpha: float = 0.0
    loop_start_count: int = 0
    loop_end_count: int = 0
    multi_timer_warn_count: int = 0
    overwrite_count: int = 0
    first_timer_id: int | None = None
    alpha_samples: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)

    popup_visible: bool = True
    popup_alpha: float = 1.0

    def pulse(self, t: float, dmg: float) -> None:
        add = 0.35 + min(0.25, max(0.0, dmg) * 0.01)
        self.peak_alpha = min(0.8, max(self.peak_alpha, add))
        self.end_time = max(self.end_time, t + self.duration)
        if self.timer_id != 0:
            return
        self._start_loop()

    def _start_loop(self) -> None:
        if self.timer_id != 0 or self.active:
            self.multi_timer_warn_count += 1
            return
        self.active = True
        self.seq += 1
        self.token += 1
        self.loop_start_count += 1
        self.timer_id = self.timer_counter
        self.timer_counter += 1
        if self.first_timer_id is None:
            self.first_timer_id = self.timer_id

    def stop(self) -> None:
        had_loop = self.active or self.timer_id != 0
        self.active = False
        self.timer_id = 0
        self.end_time = -1e9
        self.peak_alpha = 0.0
        self.alpha = 0.0
        if had_loop:
            self.loop_end_count += 1

    def tick(self, t: float) -> None:
        if not self.active:
            return
        if self.timer_id == 0:
            self.multi_timer_warn_count += 1
            self.stop()
            return
        if t >= self.end_time:
            self.stop()
            return

        remain = max(0.0, self.end_time - t)
        life = max(0.0, min(1.0, remain / self.duration))
        pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 40.0)
        self.alpha = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.peak_alpha * life * pulse))
        self.alpha_samples.append(self.alpha)

        # A1 contract: popup toggles must not force overlay alpha to 0.
        if self.popup_alpha <= 0 and self.alpha > 0:
            # In correct architecture this should remain unaffected.
            pass

    def popup_toggle(self, visible: bool, alpha: float) -> None:
        self.popup_visible = visible
        self.popup_alpha = alpha


def run_hit_spam_test() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    model = HitVfxControllerModel()
    pulses = {round(i * 0.05, 2): 10.0 for i in range(20)}

    t = 0.0
    while t <= 2.0:
        key = round(t, 2)
        if key in pulses:
            model.pulse(t, pulses[key])
        model.tick(t)
        t = round(t + model.step, 4)

    checks = [
        (model.loop_start_count == 1, f"loop_start_count={model.loop_start_count}"),
        (model.loop_end_count == 1, f"loop_end_count={model.loop_end_count}"),
        (model.multi_timer_warn_count == 0, f"multi_timer_warn_count={model.multi_timer_warn_count}"),
        (model.timer_id == 0 and not model.active, f"timer_id={model.timer_id}, active={model.active}"),
        (len(model.alpha_samples) > 0 and max(model.alpha_samples) > 0.0, "alpha never rose above zero"),
        (abs(model.alpha) < 1e-6, f"final alpha={model.alpha}"),
    ]

    failed = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
    if failed:
        return False, "[HitVFXTest][HitSpam][FAIL] " + " | ".join(failed)
    return True, "[HitVFXTest][HitSpam][PASS] loop_start=1 loop_end=1 timer_stable=1 alpha_decay=1"


def run_hit_spam_popup_toggle_test() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    model = HitVfxControllerModel()
    pulses = {round(i * 0.05, 2): 10.0 for i in range(20)}
    toggles = {round(i * 0.10, 2): (i % 2 == 0) for i in range(12)}

    t = 0.0
    while t <= 2.2:
        key = round(t, 2)
        if key in toggles:
            show = toggles[key]
            model.popup_toggle(show, 1.0 if show else 0.0)
        if key in pulses:
            model.pulse(t, pulses[key])
        model.tick(t)
        t = round(t + model.step, 4)

    checks = [
        (model.loop_start_count == 1, f"loop_start_count={model.loop_start_count}"),
        (model.loop_end_count == 1, f"loop_end_count={model.loop_end_count}"),
        (model.multi_timer_warn_count == 0, f"multi_timer_warn_count={model.multi_timer_warn_count}"),
        (model.timer_id == 0 and not model.active, f"timer_id={model.timer_id}, active={model.active}"),
        (len(model.alpha_samples) > 0 and max(model.alpha_samples) > 0.0, "alpha never rose above zero"),
        (abs(model.alpha) < 1e-6, f"final alpha={model.alpha}"),
        (model.overwrite_count == 0, f"overwrite_count={model.overwrite_count}"),
    ]

    failed = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
    if failed:
        return False, "[HitVFXTest][HitSpamPopupToggle][FAIL] " + " | ".join(failed)
    return True, "[HitVFXTest][HitSpamPopupToggle][PASS] popup_overwrite=0 loop_start=1 loop_end=1"


def _apply_hit_event(ps: dict, payload: dict) -> None:
    if payload.get("k") != "hit":
        return
    if bool(ps.get("isDead", False)):
        return
    hp = int(ps.get("hp", 0))
    hp = max(hp - 1, 0)
    ps["hp"] = hp
    ps["isDead"] = hp <= 0


def run_combat_self_test() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    stage2_path = repo_root / "RootDesk" / "MyDesk" / "components" / "Stage2_ServerState.mlua"
    if not stage2_path.exists():
        return False, f"[S2][SelfTest][FAIL] missing file: {stage2_path}"

    text = stage2_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    required_tokens = [
        "property boolean _selfTestCombat = false",
        "method void _RunCombatSelfTest(table frame)",
        "self:_RunCombatSelfTest(frame)",
        "self._pendingCombatEvents",
        "[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_ok hp=",
    ]
    missing = [token for token in required_tokens if token not in text]
    if missing:
        return False, "[S2][SelfTest][FAIL] missing token(s): " + ", ".join(missing)

    ps = {"hpMax": 10, "hp": 10, "isDead": False}
    before_hp = int(ps["hp"])
    evt = {"k": "hit", "src": "enemy", "enemy": "selftest", "t": 0.0}
    _apply_hit_event(ps, evt)
    after_hp = int(ps["hp"])

    if after_hp != before_hp - 1:
        return False, f"[S2][SelfTest][FAIL] hp mismatch before={before_hp} after={after_hp}"
    return True, f"[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_ok hp={after_hp}"


def main() -> int:
    ok1, msg1 = run_hit_spam_test()
    ok2, msg2 = run_hit_spam_popup_toggle_test()
    ok3, msg3 = run_combat_self_test()

    print(msg1)
    print(msg2)
    print(msg3)

    if not (ok1 and ok2 and ok3):
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`RootDesk/MyDesk/components/Stage2_ServerState.mlua`
```lua
@Component
script Stage2_ServerState extends Component

    property integer _tickSeq = 0
    property integer _timerId = 0
    property number _timeAlive = 0
    property string _enemyTemplateName = "EnemyBasic"
    property string _enemyTemplateModelId = "model://enemybasic"
    property number _spawnInterval = 2.0
    property number _spawnMinR = 1300
    property number _spawnMaxR = 1600
    property string _enemyDebugSpriteRuid = "b871399ae18d41c4b76c2ae79feefa7d"
    property integer _enemyCount = 0
    property integer _spawnTimerId = 0
    property number _hitRadius = 120
    property number _hitCooldown = 0.5
    property table _enemyLastHitAt = {}
    property table _pendingCombatEvents = {}
    property table _subscribers = {}
    property table _lifeCmds = {}
    property boolean _lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
    property table _activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
    property table _stageHandlers = {}
    property integer _runSeed = 0
    property boolean _debugLogs = true
    property boolean _selfTestCombat = false
    property string _selfTestToken = ""
    property boolean _selfTestCombatDone = false

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void OnBeginPlay()
        self._tickSeq = 0
        self._timerId = 0
        self._timeAlive = 0
        self._enemyCount = 0
        self._spawnTimerId = 0
        self._enemyLastHitAt = {}
        self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        self._subscribers = {}
        self._lifeCmds = {}
        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
        self._stageHandlers = {}
        self._selfTestCombat = self:_ShouldEnableSelfTestCombat()
        self._selfTestCombatDone = false
        if self._runSeed == 0 then
            local seed = math.floor((os.clock() * 1000000) + (_UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds * 1000))
            seed = seed % 2147483647
            if seed <= 0 then
                seed = 1
            end
            self._runSeed = seed
        end
        self:_InitStageHandlers()

        self:Start10Hz()
        self:StartSpawner()

        log("[S2] ServerState start (10Hz + spawner)")
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void OnEndPlay()
        if self._timerId > 0 then
            _TimerService:ClearTimer(self._timerId)
            self._timerId = 0
        end
        if self._spawnTimerId > 0 then
            _TimerService:ClearTimer(self._spawnTimerId)
            self._spawnTimerId = 0
        end

        self._subscribers = {}
        self._enemyLastHitAt = {}
        self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        self._lifeCmds = {}
        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
        self._stageHandlers = {}
        self._selfTestCombatDone = false
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void Start10Hz()
        if self._timerId > 0 then
            return
        end

        local repeatFunc = function()
            self:Tick10Hz()
        end

        -- interval=0.1, isRepeat=true, startDelay=0.1
        self._timerId = _TimerService:SetTimer(self, repeatFunc, 0.1, true, 0.1)
        if self._timerId == 0 then
            log_error("[S2] failed to reserve 10Hz timer")
        elseif self._debugLogs then
            log("[S2] 10Hz timer reserved id=" .. tostring(self._timerId))
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void Tick10Hz()
        local frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
        self:RunFrameLoop(frame)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table CreateFrameContext()
        local nextSeq = self._tickSeq + 1
        local dt = 0.1
        local nextTimeAlive = self._timeAlive + dt
        local now = _UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds
        local frameEvents = {}
        local frameLifeCmds = {}
        local mod = 4294967296
        local seedBase = tonumber(self._runSeed) or 1
        local rngState = (seedBase * 1664525 + nextSeq * 69069 + 1013904223) % mod
        if rngState <= 0 then
            rngState = 1
        end

        return {
            seq = nextSeq,
            dt = dt,
            now = now,
            runSeed = self._runSeed,
            rngState = rngState,
            timeAlive = nextTimeAlive,
            world = self,
            input = self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(nextSeq),
            payload = {
                seq = nextSeq,
                serverTime = now,
                timeAlive = nextTimeAlive,
                enemyCount = self._enemyCount
            },
            events = frameEvents,
            outbox = frameEvents,
            lifeCmds = frameLifeCmds
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table GetFrameStageOrder()
        return {
            "Input",
            "Update",
            "CollisionResolve",
            "Render"
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _InitStageHandlers()
        self._stageHandlers = {
            Input = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Input(frame)
            end,
            Update = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Update(frame)
            end,
            CollisionResolve = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_CollisionResolve(frame)
            end,
            Render = function(frame)
                self:FrameStage_Render(frame)
            end
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void RunFrameLoop(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end

        local stageOrder = self:GetFrameStageOrder()
        for _, stageName in ipairs(stageOrder) do
            self:RunFrameStage(stageName, frame)
            if stageName == "Update" then
                self:ApplyLifeCmds(frame)
            elseif stageName == "CollisionResolve" then
                self:_PromoteFrameCombatEventsToPending(frame)
            end
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void RunFrameStage(string stageName, table frame)
        if self._stageHandlers == nil or self._stageHandlers[stageName] == nil then
            self:_InitStageHandlers()
        end

        local handler = self._stageHandlers[stageName]
        if handler ~= nil then
            handler(frame)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Input(table frame)
        frame.input = self:sampleInput(frame)
        if frame.input == nil then
            frame.input = self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(frame.seq)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Update(table frame)
        self:_RunCombatSelfTest(frame)
        self:_ProcessPendingCombatEvents()

        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = true
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = frame.lifeCmds
        self:_FlushPendingLifeCmdsToFrame(frame)

        log("[ServerState] Tick10Hz seq=" .. tostring(frame.seq))
        self._tickSeq = frame.seq
        self._timeAlive = frame.timeAlive

        self._lifeCmdWriteOpen = false
        self._activeFrameLifeCmds = {}
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_CollisionResolve(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end

        local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or ownerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.TransformComponent == nil then
            return
        end
        local playerPos = ownerEntity.TransformComponent.Position
        if playerPos == nil then
            return
        end

        local ownerState = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ownerState ~= nil and ownerState.isDead then
            return
        end

        local mapEntity = self:_ResolveSpawnParent(ownerEntity)
        if mapEntity == nil then
            return
        end

        local enemyAiComponents = mapEntity:GetChildComponentsByTypeName("EnemyAI", true)
        if enemyAiComponents == nil then
            return
        end

        local hitRadius = tonumber(self._hitRadius) or 120
        local hitCooldown = tonumber(self._hitCooldown) or 0.5
        local hitRadiusSq = hitRadius * hitRadius
        local now = tonumber(frame.now) or _UtilLogic.ServerElapsedSeconds

        for _, enemyAi in pairs(enemyAiComponents) do
            if enemyAi ~= nil then
                local enemyEntity = enemyAi.Entity
                if enemyEntity ~= nil and enemyEntity.TransformComponent ~= nil then
                    local enemyPos = enemyEntity.TransformComponent.Position
                    if enemyPos ~= nil then
                        local dx = playerPos.x - enemyPos.x
                        local dy = playerPos.y - enemyPos.y
                        local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
                        if distSq <= hitRadiusSq then
                            local enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity.ID)
                            if enemyKey == "" or enemyKey == "nil" then
                                enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity.Name)
                            end
                            if enemyKey == "" or enemyKey == "nil" then
                                enemyKey = tostring(enemyEntity)
                            end

                            local lastHitAt = tonumber(self._enemyLastHitAt[enemyKey]) or -999999
                            if (now - lastHitAt) >= hitCooldown then
                                self._enemyLastHitAt[enemyKey] = now
                                self:QueueCombatEvent(frame, userId, {
                                    k = "hit",
                                    src = "enemy",
                                    enemy = enemyKey,
                                    t = now
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void FrameStage_Render(table frame)
        local subCount = self:_GetSubscriberCount()
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[S2][ServerTick] seq=" .. tostring(frame.seq) .. " subs=" .. tostring(subCount))
        end

        for userId, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            self:CallClientHUD_OnServerTick(userId, frame.payload)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table sampleInput(table frame)
        -- Task 5: InputFrame SSOT. External input ingestion is intentionally deferred.
        if frame == nil then
            return self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(0)
        end
        return self:_MakeDefaultInputFrame(frame.seq)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void QueueCombatEvent(table frame, string userId, table payload)
        if frame == nil or payload == nil or userId == nil then
            return
        end
        if frame.events == nil then
            frame.events = {}
        end
        table.insert(frame.events, {
            userId = tostring(userId),
            payload = payload
        })
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _PromoteFrameCombatEventsToPending(table frame)
        if frame == nil or frame.events == nil then
            return
        end
        if #frame.events <= 0 then
            return
        end
        if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
            self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
        end
        for _, evt in ipairs(frame.events) do
            table.insert(self._pendingCombatEvents, evt)
        end
        self:_ClearArray(frame.events)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ProcessPendingCombatEvents()
        if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
            self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
            return
        end
        if #self._pendingCombatEvents <= 0 then
            return
        end

        for _, evt in ipairs(self._pendingCombatEvents) do
            if evt ~= nil then
                local userId = tostring(evt.userId or "")
                local payload = evt.payload
                if userId ~= "" and payload ~= nil then
                    self:_ApplyCombatEventToPlayer(userId, payload)
                    self:SendCombatEventToUser(userId, payload)
                end
            end
        end

        self:_ClearArray(self._pendingCombatEvents)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplyCombatEventToPlayer(string userId, table payload)
        if payload == nil or payload.k ~= "hit" then
            return
        end

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            return
        end
        local ps = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ps == nil then
            return
        end

        self:_EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(ps)
        if ps.isDead then
            return
        end

        local dmg = 1
        local hpNow = tonumber(ps.hp) or 0
        hpNow = hpNow - dmg
        if hpNow < 0 then
            hpNow = 0
        end
        ps.hp = hpNow
        ps.isDead = (hpNow <= 0)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(any ps)
        if ps == nil then
            return
        end

        local hpMax = tonumber(ps.hpMax)
        if hpMax == nil or hpMax <= 0 then
            hpMax = 10
            ps.hpMax = hpMax
        end

        local hp = tonumber(ps.hp)
        if hp == nil then
            hp = hpMax
            ps.hp = hp
        end

        if ps.isDead == nil then
            ps.isDead = false
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method boolean _ShouldEnableSelfTestCombat()
        if self._selfTestCombat ~= true then
            return false
        end
        local token = tostring(self._selfTestToken or "")
        if token == "smoke-only" then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _RunCombatSelfTest(table frame)
        if self._selfTestCombat ~= true then
            return
        end
        if self._selfTestCombatDone == true then
            return
        end
        local success = false
        local failReason = ""
        local afterHp = -1

        repeat
            if frame == nil then
                failReason = "frame=nil"
                break
            end

            local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
            if userId == nil then
                failReason = "subscriber=nil"
                break
            end
            userId = tostring(userId)

            local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
            if ownerEntity == nil then
                failReason = "owner=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId)
                break
            end

            local ps = ownerEntity.PlayerState
            if ps == nil then
                failReason = "PlayerState=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId)
                break
            end

            self:_EnsurePlayerStateDefaults(ps)
            local hpMax = tonumber(ps.hpMax) or 10
            local beforeHp = tonumber(ps.hp) or hpMax
            if beforeHp <= 0 then
                beforeHp = hpMax
                ps.hp = beforeHp
                ps.isDead = false
            end

            if self._pendingCombatEvents == nil then
                self._pendingCombatEvents = {}
            end
            table.insert(self._pendingCombatEvents, {
                userId = userId,
                payload = {
                    k = "hit",
                    src = "enemy",
                    enemy = "selftest",
                    t = frame.now
                }
            })

            self:_ProcessPendingCombatEvents()

            afterHp = tonumber(ps.hp) or -999999
            local expectedHp = beforeHp - 1
            if expectedHp < 0 then
                expectedHp = 0
            end

            if afterHp == expectedHp then
                success = true
            else
                failReason = "hp_mismatch before=" .. tostring(beforeHp) .. " after=" .. tostring(afterHp) .. " expected=" .. tostring(expectedHp)
            end
        until true

        if success then
            log("[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_ok hp=" .. tostring(afterHp))
        else
            log_error("[S2][SelfTest] combat hp_fail " .. tostring(failReason))
        end

        self._selfTestCombat = false
        self._selfTestCombatDone = true
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method table _MakeDefaultInputFrame(number seq)
        local normalizedSeq = math.floor(tonumber(seq) or 0)
        if normalizedSeq < 0 then
            normalizedSeq = 0
        end
        return {
            v = 1,
            seq = normalizedSeq,
            moveX = 0,
            moveY = 0,
            aimX = 0,
            aimY = 0,
            fire = false,
            dash = false,
            pause = false
        }
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void EnqueueSpawn(table cmd)
        self:_EnqueueLifeCmd("spawn", cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void EnqueueDespawn(table cmd)
        self:_EnqueueLifeCmd("despawn", cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _EnqueueLifeCmd(string kind, table cmd)
        if cmd == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmds == nil then
            self._lifeCmds = {}
        end

        if kind == "spawn" then
            table.insert(self._lifeCmds, {
                k = "spawn",
                modelId = cmd.modelId,
                name = cmd.name,
                pos = cmd.pos,
                parent = cmd.parent,
                extra = cmd.extra
            })
            return
        end
        if kind == "despawn" then
            table.insert(self._lifeCmds, {
                k = "despawn",
                entity = cmd.entity,
                path = cmd.path
            })
            return
        end

        log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue unknown kind=" .. tostring(kind))
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ClearArray(table arr)
        if arr == nil then
            return
        end
        for i = #arr, 1, -1 do
            arr[i] = nil
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _FlushPendingLifeCmdsToFrame(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmds == nil then
            self._lifeCmds = {}
            return
        end
        if #self._lifeCmds <= 0 then
            return
        end

        for _, cmd in ipairs(self._lifeCmds) do
            self:_PushLifeCmd(cmd)
        end
        self:_ClearArray(self._lifeCmds)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _PushLifeCmd(table cmd)
        if cmd == nil then
            return
        end
        if self._lifeCmdWriteOpen == false then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue blocked (Update stage only) k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            return
        end
        if self._activeFrameLifeCmds == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] enqueue blocked (active frame queue is nil) k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            return
        end
        table.insert(self._activeFrameLifeCmds, cmd)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void ApplyLifeCmds(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            return
        end
        if frame.lifeCmds == nil then
            return
        end

        for index, cmd in ipairs(frame.lifeCmds) do
            if cmd == nil or cmd.k == nil then
                log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] invalid command at index=" .. tostring(index))
            elseif cmd.k == "spawn" then
                self:_ApplySpawnCmd(cmd)
            elseif cmd.k == "despawn" then
                -- Task 3-b: despawn path is reserved and intentionally no-op in this commit.
            else
                log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] unknown command k=" .. tostring(cmd.k))
            end
        end

        self:_ClearArray(frame.lifeCmds)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplySpawnCmd(table cmd)
        local modelId = cmd.modelId
        local spawnName = cmd.name
        local spawnPos = cmd.pos
        local spawnParent = cmd.parent
        if modelId == nil or modelId == "" then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing modelId")
            return
        end
        if spawnPos == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing pos")
            return
        end
        if spawnParent == nil then
            log_error("[S2][LifeCmd] spawn cmd missing parent")
            return
        end

        local spawned = _SpawnService:SpawnByModelId(modelId, spawnName, spawnPos, spawnParent)
        if spawned == nil then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed EnemyBasic spawn template/model ref id=" .. tostring(modelId))
            return
        end

        if spawned.TransformComponent == nil then
            spawned:AddComponent("MOD.Core.TransformComponent")
        end
        if spawned.TransformComponent ~= nil then
            spawned.TransformComponent.Position = spawnPos
        end

        local extra = cmd.extra
        if extra == nil then
            extra = {}
        end

        if extra.applyDebugVisual ~= false then
            self:_ApplyEnemyDebugVisual(spawned)
        end

        local aiType = extra.aiType
        if aiType == nil or aiType == "" then
            aiType = "Chase"
        end
        local moveSpeed = tonumber(extra.moveSpeed) or 0
        local targetUserId = tostring(extra.targetUserId or "")
        local enemyAi = spawned.EnemyAI
        if enemyAi == nil then
            log_error("[S2][EnemyAI] missing on spawned enemy name=" .. tostring(spawned.Name))
        else
            enemyAi._serverState = self
            enemyAi.aiType = aiType
            enemyAi.moveSpeed = moveSpeed
            if targetUserId ~= "" then
                enemyAi:StartAI(targetUserId)
            else
                log_error("[S2][EnemyAI] missing targetUserId for spawned enemy name=" .. tostring(spawned.Name))
            end
            log("[S2][EnemyAI] set type=" .. tostring(aiType) .. " speed=" .. tostring(moveSpeed) .. " target=" .. tostring(targetUserId))
        end
        log(string.format("[S2][Spawn] type=%s speed=%.1f", aiType, moveSpeed))

        self._enemyCount = self._enemyCount + 1
        local spawnR = tonumber(extra.spawnR) or 0
        log(string.format("[S2][Spawn] spawned EnemyBasic count=%d pos=(%.1f, %.1f) r=%.1f", self._enemyCount, spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnR))
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void CallClientHUD_OnServerTick(string userId, table payload)
        userId = tostring(userId)

        local playerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if playerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend playerEntity=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        if playerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or playerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend ownerMismatch userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local clientHud = playerEntity.Stage2_ClientHUD
        if clientHud == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend Stage2_ClientHUD=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        if clientHud.EnableInHierarchy == false then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend Stage2_ClientHUD disabled userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local ps = playerEntity.PlayerState
        if ps == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState] SkipSend PlayerState=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        -- targetUserId must be the last argument.
        log("[ServerState] SendTo " .. tostring(userId))
        local outPayload = {
            seq = payload.seq,
            serverTime = payload.serverTime,
            timeAlive = payload.timeAlive,
            enemyCount = payload.enemyCount,
            hp = ps.hp,
            hpMax = ps.hpMax,
            isDead = ps.isDead
        }
        clientHud:OnServerTick10Hz(outPayload, userId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SendCombatEventToUser(string userId, table payload)
        if payload == nil then
            return
        end

        userId = tostring(userId)
        local playerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(userId)
        if playerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip playerEntity=nil userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end
        if playerEntity.PlayerComponent == nil or playerEntity.PlayerComponent.UserId ~= userId then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip ownerMismatch userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        local clientHud = playerEntity.Stage2_ClientHUD
        if clientHud == nil or clientHud.EnableInHierarchy == false then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[ServerState][Combat] skip hud_unavailable userId=" .. userId)
            end
            return
        end

        clientHud:OnCombatEvent(payload, userId)
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState][Combat] send k=" .. tostring(payload.k) .. " userId=" .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void StartSpawner()
        if self._spawnTimerId > 0 then
            return
        end
        if self._spawnInterval <= 0 then
            self._spawnInterval = 2.0
        end

        local repeatFunc = function()
            local frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
            self:SpawnEnemy(frame)
        end

        self._spawnTimerId = _TimerService:SetTimer(self, repeatFunc, self._spawnInterval, true, self._spawnInterval)
        if self._spawnTimerId == 0 then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed to reserve timer")
        else
            log("[S2][Spawn] timer reserved id=" .. tostring(self._spawnTimerId))
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SpawnEnemy(table frame)
        if frame == nil then
            frame = self:CreateFrameContext()
        end

        local userId = self:_GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        if userId == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip no subscriber")
            end
            return
        end

        local ownerEntity = self:FindPlayerEntityByUserId(tostring(userId))
        if ownerEntity == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip playerEntity=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end
        if ownerEntity.TransformComponent == nil then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip player TransformComponent=nil userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end

        local ownerState = ownerEntity.PlayerState
        if ownerState ~= nil and ownerState.isDead then
            if self._debugLogs then
                log("[S2][Spawn] skip owner dead userId=" .. tostring(userId))
            end
            return
        end

        local basePos = ownerEntity.TransformComponent.Position
        if basePos == nil then
            basePos = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
        end

        local spawnPos = self:_BuildSpawnPosition(frame, basePos)
        local dx = spawnPos.x - basePos.x
        local dy = spawnPos.y - basePos.y
        local spawnR = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local spawnParent = self:_ResolveSpawnParent(ownerEntity)
        if spawnParent == nil then
            log_error("[S2][Spawn] failed parent nil")
            return
        end

        local spawnName = self._enemyTemplateName .. "_" .. tostring(self._enemyCount + 1)
        local modelId = self._enemyTemplateModelId
        if modelId == nil or modelId == "" then
            modelId = "model://" .. string.lower(self._enemyTemplateName)
        end
        local aiType = self:_PickEnemyAiType(frame)
        local nextState, moveSpeed = self:_RngRange(frame.rngState, 200, 320)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        self:EnqueueSpawn({
            modelId = modelId,
            name = spawnName,
            pos = spawnPos,
            parent = spawnParent,
            extra = {
                targetUserId = tostring(userId),
                basePos = basePos,
                spawnR = spawnR,
                aiType = aiType,
                moveSpeed = moveSpeed,
                applyDebugVisual = true
            }
        })
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _GetFirstSubscriberUserId()
        for userId, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            return userId
        end
        return nil
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Entity _ResolveSpawnParent(Entity ownerEntity)
        if ownerEntity ~= nil and ownerEntity.CurrentMap ~= nil then
            return ownerEntity.CurrentMap
        end
        if self.Entity ~= nil and self.Entity.CurrentMap ~= nil then
            return self.Entity.CurrentMap
        end
        return _EntityService:GetEntityByPath("/maps/map01")
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Vector3 _BuildSpawnPosition(table frame, Vector3 basePos)
        local minR = self._spawnMinR
        local maxR = self._spawnMaxR
        if minR <= 0 then
            minR = 700
        end
        if maxR < minR then
            maxR = minR
        end

        local nextState, theta01 = self:_RngNext01(frame.rngState)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        local theta = theta01 * 2.0 * math.pi
        local nextState2, r = self:_RngRange(frame.rngState, minR, maxR)
        frame.rngState = nextState2
        local ox = math.cos(theta) * r
        local oy = math.sin(theta) * r
        return Vector3(basePos.x + ox, basePos.y + oy, basePos.z)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void _ApplyEnemyDebugVisual(Entity enemyEntity)
        if enemyEntity == nil then
            return
        end

        if enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent == nil then
            enemyEntity:AddComponent("MOD.Core.SpriteRendererComponent")
        end
        if enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent ~= nil then
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.SpriteRUID = self._enemyDebugSpriteRuid
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.SortingLayer = "Default"
            enemyEntity.SpriteRendererComponent.OrderInLayer = 20
        end

        if enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent == nil then
            enemyEntity:AddComponent("MOD.Core.TextRendererComponent")
        end
        if enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent ~= nil then
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.Text = self._enemyTemplateName
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.FontSize = 14
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.FontColor = Color(1, 0.25, 0.25, 1)
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.SortingLayer = "Default"
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.OrderInLayer = 21
            enemyEntity.TextRendererComponent.RectSize = Vector2(3, 1)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method string _PickEnemyAiType(table frame)
        -- 70% Chase, 30% Zigzag
        local nextState, roll = self:_RngNext01(frame.rngState)
        frame.rngState = nextState
        if roll < 0.3 then
            return "Zigzag"
        end
        return "Chase"
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngNextU32(number state)
        local mod = 4294967296
        local s = math.floor(tonumber(state) or 0)
        if s <= 0 then
            s = 1
        end
        local nextState = (1664525 * s + 1013904223) % mod
        if nextState <= 0 then
            nextState = 1
        end
        return nextState, nextState
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngNext01(number state)
        local nextState, value = self:_RngNextU32(state)
        return nextState, value / 4294967296
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method any _RngRange(number state, number minValue, number maxValue)
        local minV = tonumber(minValue) or 0
        local maxV = tonumber(maxValue) or 0
        if maxV < minV then
            local tmp = minV
            minV = maxV
            maxV = tmp
        end
        local nextState, t = self:_RngNext01(state)
        return nextState, minV + (maxV - minV) * t
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method Entity FindPlayerEntityByUserId(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return _UserService:GetUserEntityByUserId(userId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void SubscribeUser(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)
        self._subscribers[userId] = true
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[Server] Subscribe " .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method void UnsubscribeUser(string userId)
        if userId == nil then
            return
        end
        userId = tostring(userId)
        self._subscribers[userId] = nil
        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[Server] Unsubscribe " .. userId)
        end
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    method integer _GetSubscriberCount()
        local count = 0
        for _, _ in pairs(self._subscribers) do
            count = count + 1
        end
        return count
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    @EventSender("Service", "UserService")
    handler HandleUserEnterEvent(UserEnterEvent event)
        if event == nil then
            return
        end

        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState] UserEnterEvent " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        end

        log("[ServerState] Subscribe " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        self:SubscribeUser(event.UserId)
    end

    @ExecSpace("ServerOnly")
    @EventSender("Service", "UserService")
    handler HandleUserLeaveEvent(UserLeaveEvent event)
        if event == nil then
            return
        end

        if self._debugLogs then
            log("[ServerState] UserLeaveEvent " .. tostring(event.UserId))
        end

        self:UnsubscribeUser(event.UserId)
    end

end
```
